refusals.SEQ_MISSING: The pattern needs one running number, e.g. {example}

refusals.SEQ_WIDTH: The running number needs at least 1 digit, e.g. {example}
refusals.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: Unknown code {tokens}; use the codes from the list
refusals.YEAR_MISSING: Counting again every year or month needs the year in the number, otherwise next year repeats this year's numbers. Add a year code, or choose never

tokens.DEPT: Code of the department charged, e.g. CON
tokens.SEQ: Running number padded with zeros to its width, e.g. {example} = 00001; it grows wider by itself
